description: This file defines a Flutter widget MyRidesFragment that displays a list of static ride history entries and an active rides section, serving as a UI component for a ridesharing app. It mimics a Kotlin fragment in a Flutter context, with layout and styling for ride details.

classes.name: MyRidesFragment
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays previous ride entries and active ride status in a scrollable view.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the MyRidesFragment, including static ride cards and an active ride placeholder.

methods.name: _buildRideCard
methods.description: Helper method to create a styled card widget representing a single ride entry with status, location, date, and fare details.
